sentences.en: On Tuesday, funerals for the children killed at Robb Elementary began in Uvalde.

sentences.en: Many of them will be buried in specially designed caskets, decorated with their favorite sports and cartoon characters.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人将被安葬在特制的棺木中，棺木上装饰着他们最喜欢的体育和卡通人物。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Supreme Court blocked a Texas law that would ban large social media companies from removing posts based on the views contained in them.
sentences.zh: 星期二，最高法院叫停了一项得克萨斯州法律，该法律原本禁止大型社交媒体公司根据帖子的观点删除内容。

sentences.en: The case is moving through the lower courts, and the 5-4 vote suspends the Texas law while it is being litigated.
sentences.zh: 该案正在下级法院审理中，5比4的投票结果在诉讼期间暂停了这项得州法律。

sentences.en: Supporters of the law say it was an attempt to combat what they called Silicon Valley's censorship of conservative views.
sentences.zh: 该法律的支持者表示，此举是为了打击他们所称的“硅谷对保守派观点的审查”。

sentences.en: The law was prompted in part by the decisions of some platforms to bar former President Donald
sentences.zh: 该法律的出台，部分原因是某些平台在1月6日国会山骚乱后决定封禁前总统唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump after the January 6th attack on the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: The case may well eventually end up at the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这个案件最终很可能会上诉到最高法院。

sentences.en: Justice Samuel Alito wrote in a dissent that the issues raised in it were so novel and significant that the court would have to consider them at some point.
sentences.zh: 大法官塞缪尔·阿利托（Samuel Alito）在一份异议书中写道，其中提出的问题如此新颖且重大，以至于法院在某个时候必须对它们进行审理。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时的一场选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持其影响力却又在过程中失控的故事。
